calls.thesis: Emcor, electrical/HVAC contractor: half of revenue from data centers; backlog grew $12B to $17B (~50%) and blue-collar workforce from 34k to 44k; market is not pricing the next few years of growth.
calls.base: Hyperscaler capex $800B this year toward $1.2T; skilled-labor bottleneck (500k-1M more electricians needed) keeps revenue opportunity durable.
calls.bear: AI-capex air pocket (election-year NIMBYism narrative) has already dragged AI-infrastructure names down 20-30%.
calls.video_title: The AI Boom Is Creating Blue Collar Millionaires (3 Stocks You'll Wish You Bought)
